verdict.rationale: 1Password's own docs say it can store and quickly access one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website, and those codes are also viewable on Apple Watch. That covers the core TOTP-generation part of the story, but no evidence documents the QR-code scanning setup step. The Wi-Fi QR codes mention is a different feature and does not count. missing for 10: documented QR-code scanning to add a TOTP secret, evidence of immediate code generation after setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
